items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: played with a guy named Leo Quizier.

ctx.x: Who'd you work at the Caledonia with? Who, when you played there? I worked there about two weeks with a guy, he needed a trumpet player and he actually
played with a guy named Leo Quizier. Oh okay. Waddell's brother. Brother.

Brother. Okay. He played drums and they had a guy named Warren Hebar played tenor saxophone. And a guy called Big Sam played drums. And the piano player was Johnny Fernandez. Oh Senior. So you only played there once. Was that, that was a, that was a, you know, a guy called Big Sam played drums. And the piano player was Johnny Fernandez.
